{{Top|leg}}
A '''fortune teller''' was a being who would predict an individual's futures. Some fortune tellers were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and used their connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to make accurate predictions. The [[Sljee (species)|Sljee]] [[Jeseej]] was a Force-sensitive fortune teller.

Local [[haruspex]]es on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]] used the entrails of native [[toccat]]s to give a prophetic reading as part of their grassroots fortune-telling business.<ref name="Greater Javin">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref>
